state_meaning: 8-D: x/y position, x/y velocity, angle, angular velocity, 2 leg-contact flags
reward: shaped landing reward; +100 safe landing, -100 crash; solved ≈ 200
why_lunarlander: Harder continuous-state control with 4 discrete actions and a shaped reward — closest game analogue to managing a position with multiple discrete trade actions.

reinforce.note: Vanilla Monte-Carlo policy gradient; explicit loss = -log π(a|s) * G_t
